# Musical Sprouts

> Toddler and preschool music classes in Collingwood, Ontario — songs, rhythm, and connection for little ones and their grown-ups.

Musical Sprouts offers early childhood music classes at Christ Our Hope Lutheran Church, 9874 Beachwood Rd, Collingwood, ON. Classes run Thursdays and Fridays (40 minutes, max 12 families). Options include a $20 trial, 7-week sessions, a flexible monthly membership, and drop-ins. Payment is by e-transfer to contactmusicalsprouts@gmail.com.

## Site

- [Home](https://musicalsprouts.com/): Overview, classes, how to book
- [Pricing & registration](https://musicalsprouts.com/pricing): Trial, session, membership, drop-in, FAQ
- [Blog](https://musicalsprouts.com/blog): Music and the developing brain
